summary: IM Cannabis Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting a June 3, 2026 note purchase agreement with an institutional investor. The company issued a US$225,000 convertible note (issued at 90% of face value) and a warrant to purchase up to 781,250 common shares at CAD$0.40 per share. Proceeds of US$202,500 are for general corporate purposes. The note carries 8% interest (14% upon default) and converts at the lower of US$0.288 fixed or 90% of the 20-day VWAP, subject to a US$0.0576 floor. A 4.99% beneficial ownership cap applies. The company must file a resale registration statement. This is a structured equity financing, not a transformative special situation. Watch for dilution and registration effectiveness.
